scientific_limitations: Applies to a finite cosine sum with Lebesgue-uniform initial point and integer expansion factors at least two; arbitrary observation functions or noninteger slopes are not covered.
Exact recovery determines only doubling multiplicity and consecutive doubling pairs, not the complete binary switching schedule.
Finite exhaustive diagnostics do not replace the proved general Fourier resonance classification; equivalent old formulas could exist in uncatalogued work.
title: Third- and fourth-order resonance laws detect switching in integer expanding circle maps
